supportModel.compatibilityPolicy: Candidate compatibility guidance must name exact versions, limitations, and unresolved evidence.
supportModel.deprecationPolicy: Candidate deprecation guidance preserves fallback, history, notice, and an explicit retirement review.
supportModel.incidentPath: Candidate incidents retain evidence and route to a separately authorized operational or security authority.
supportModel.appealPath: Affected participants can report harmful, incorrect, or unauthorized use for attributable review.
supportModel.escalationPath: Unavailable or conflicted reviewers produce an explicit pause or narrowed result instead of silent delegation.
supportModel.fallback: When support or realization is unavailable, stop the bounded workflow and preserve portable evidence.
supportModel.responseTarget: Candidate response targets remain proportional to consequence and require later funded approval.
supportModel.laborMeasurement: All rehearsal, facilitation, support, and review effort is recorded as candidate operating cost.

emergencyActionModel.scopeRule: Any future emergency action must be narrowly scoped to the evidenced urgent condition.
emergencyActionModel.reasonRule: The material safety, security, or operational reason must be recorded before action when feasible.
emergencyActionModel.evidenceRule: Evidence, dissent, time pressure, and the original conflict remain preserved through escalation.
emergencyActionModel.recoveryRule: A bounded recovery and safe-stop path must be identified without inferring successful restoration.
emergencyActionModel.expiryRule: Any future emergency authority must have an exact expiry and cannot silently become permanent.
emergencyActionModel.retrospectiveReviewRule: A separately authorized retrospective review must evaluate the action, recovery, and reopening triggers.
